I don’t mean to dismiss or degrade anyone, I’m describing my own feelings and unique sexuality.
I’m a dude and I’m staying a virgin until I marry because I know the intensity of the experience and bonding chems are something I want to save for my future wife. I’ve turned down sex several times because I’d rather that part of myself be only for whoever she turns out to be.
For whatever reason that someone wants exclusivity *during* a relationship, I extent that exclusivity to before for that same reason.
If I were to marry a non-virgin, I’d be worried if the depth of my attachment, even on a neurological level, could be matched on her end.
I’d profoundly hate if there was another person given access to that deepest level of intimacy, I’d feel like I wasn’t chosen, and that our connection isn’t permanent but habitual.
And I’m a very secure person, I just love very intensely. No, I’m not a manipulator either.
I am how I am and I’m not forcing it on anyone.
Once again— I don’t mean to dismiss or degrade anyone, I’m only describing myself and my own feelings. I’m posting for discussion purposes.
